top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The cribs at the operation did not have a labeling system that had the child's name, or as an alternative, having a labeling system with a number on the crib and a number/infant assignment map available to match with it in the room.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over (26 TAC §746.3701(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The TV in the stage area was not anchored. Photos were taken.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3503(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Four diaper changing areas still did not have sinks.

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Equipment- If Above Floor Level Must Use Safety Mechanism (26 TAC §746.3503(c)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was not a safety mechanisim on the above ground changing table/area.

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: No diaper changing tables wwere observed in the infant and toddler's rooms.
